target_definition.PRIMARY_MODEL_CORRECT: 1 if original predicted winner was correct, otherwise 0
target_definition.PRIMARY_MODEL_ERROR: 1 if original predicted winner was wrong, otherwise 0

model_disagreement_definition: Number of Elo, Logistic Regression, and Gradient Boosting winner predictions that disagree with the selected primary model.
team_strength_definition: Absolute difference in pre-game win percentage.
probability_note: Week 12 uses original primary-model probability for leakage-safe VALIDATION risk-model training. Week 10 calibrated probability remains a separate input for Week 13.
